room.name: The Gathic Range road
room.description:
You travel upon a road that stretches from Midgaard to the towering
mountains of the north.  The road is worn, scattered with rocks, and not
easy to travel.  The shadows of the mountains fill this road each day,
leaving everything nearby in a sort of twilight.

room.name: A dry riverbed
room.description:
This dry riverbed has been travelled, but not by many.  It is apparent
that this is no trade route, or game path, but a difficult journey even for
a hardy adventurer.  The path is not impossible, however difficult.

room.description:

shape their ore.  It is used just as heavily by those seeking out the
wonderful items the dwarves can make.  Adventures seeking a fight should
certainly do so carefully.

room.name: A steep mountain trail
room.description:
Even those hardy enough to regularly climb the mighty Gothic Range for
sport have a difficult time on this path.  It is steep enough that at times,
those walking this path must use their hands as well as their feet.  Rocks
scatter and slide with every misplaced step, and loud noises cause small
landslides.

bound.

room.name: The Gathic range
room.description:
You stand atop the tallest mountain range of the realms - The Gathic
Range.  Named for a fearless adventurer that came to the realms long ago,
coming down from these very mountains and telling tales of strange lands,
impossible to find these days.  From here, you can nearly see the entire
realm.

room.description:
To the north lies a tall mountain, one of the tallest of the Gathic
Range.  It is known only as The Hub, and according to legend was simply
placed here by the gods, unlike normal mountains, which grow slowly like
plants made of rock.  Few have dared climb this mountain, for the fear of
angering the gods of old.

room.name: Mount Filthy
room.description:
The tallest of the tall mountains, is of course, Mount Filthy.  Somewhere
on the impassible side of this peak, the mighty yet disgusting Filthy River
begins, so yes, this mountain is the one to blame.  Why from this vantage
point, you can see the entire path of the Filthy River, and how it's almost
reached the ocean.  Give it another hundred years, it may get there.

room.name: The peak of Mount Filthy
room.description:
Here, on top of the world itself, you should stop and marvel.  Before you
stretches the entire realms, and all of it is there for you to view.  For
this is the peak of Mount Filthy, believed to be the tallest mountain in the
entire world.  Only one person has ever claimed otherwise, an adventurer,
like you, that came from lands so far away that they can't smell the stench
of the Filthy River.  
Which is a VERY far way away indeed.

room.name: The Low Steppe hills
room.description:
Here the mountains end, only some hills remain - the Low Steppe hills. 
This seldom-used path you currently walk leads up into the mountains, and

room.name: The Low Steppe hills
room.description:
Here the mountains end, only some hills remain - the Low Steppe hills. 
This seldom-used path you currently walk leads up into the mountains, and
down into the plains.  It is rumored that the entrance to the strangest land
of the realms is around here...  Somewhere.
